# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.17

<!-- update-summary: 减少数据库操作对界面调用线程的占用、音乐岛重复通知与隐藏后的排帧；及时释放下载取消资源，并复用独立 CUDA 组件。 -->

## Changes

- Move paging, database initialization and affected count, pin, file-state and file-intake operations off their calling thread while preserving write admission order, transactions, cancellation and durable commit tails.
- Coalesce music-island presentation work, stop scheduling frames after the parent surface becomes hidden, prepare current content before first geometry and reuse the current animation-preference snapshot.
- Notify media-derived properties and commands only when their dependencies change. Keep track/session notifications, pause/resume presentation, lyric identity and language updates.
- Release each finished download run's cancellation source after its callbacks settle, retaining history, retry behavior, early shutdown cancellation and observable callback failures.
- Avoid the extra geometry refresh queued during synchronous first-frame preparation. Preserve the existing multi-monitor dismissal reconciliation.
- Reuse the independently versioned CUDA component `cuda-llama-cpp-v0.5.0-cuda13-win-x64-v1`. Keep exact App descriptor binding, trusted source, archive size/hash, interface checks and verified installed-component reuse. New App releases no longer upload another copy of the same CUDA archive.

## 中文说明

- 减少分页、初始化、计数、置顶、文件状态更新和拖入 SQL 对调用线程的占用；保持数据库写入顺序、事务、取消及持久提交规则。
- 合并音乐岛高频刷新，父面板真正隐藏后停止排帧，展开前同步准备最新内容和尺寸，复用动画偏好快照。
- 媒体派生属性和命令按实际依赖变化通知，保留切歌、暂停恢复、歌词身份和语言切换行为。
- 下载运行结束后及时释放取消源，并保留历史、重试、关闭取消以及取消回调错误的传递。
- 移除首帧准备产生的额外几何排队，保留双屏隐藏的补偿更新。
- App 复用固定版本的独立 CUDA 组件；保留下载信任、哈希与大小检查、接口兼容、App 描述文件绑定及安装复用。旧版资源和下载地址保持可用。

## Validation record

The preserved optimization reports record actual SQLite caller-occupation comparisons, managed notification counts, real loopback download lifetime counts and focused checks. Caller occupation is distinct from total task duration; these measurements do not establish an App-wide speedup or physical Windows frame-rate improvement.

Full Windows App/XAML compilation, current-candidate minimum key checks and final package/commit/hash/update verification are release prerequisites. This committed document is a preparation record, not an execution result. Actual results belong to the same-source-tree Windows producer's immutable Actions receipt and final published package bindings/attachments; the [Beta17 release audit](https://github.com/airanluo-dot/DropSpace/blob/main/docs/dev/beta17-release-audit.md) explains that evidence boundary. Earlier Linux source/shim checks and previous-release native observations do not substitute for current Windows evidence.

已完成的优化对照与聚焦验证见本轮报告；调用线程占用、任务总耗时和实机体验分别记录，不把局部指标包装成整个 App 的性能提升。此源码文档仅记录发布准备，实际 Windows 构建、关键验证及最终包核验结果以同一源码树的不可变 Actions 回执和发布附件为准，不把准备记录当作执行通过。

The CUDA archive, language-identification model and translation workers are unchanged. This release does not repeat CUDA archive/model downloads, GPU inference, broad model-quality surveys or unrelated full regression suites. Existing Hy-MT2 semantic, latency and hardware qualification remains incomplete and disclosed; no new model approval is claimed.

## Compatibility

Semantic version: 0.3.1-beta.17. PE/MSIX version: 0.3.1.17.
v0.3.1-beta.16 is the immediate upgrade baseline. Stable remains v0.2.1.
Existing settings, files, download history, models and verified CUDA installations are retained. AI translation remains optional and off by default. No new DLC framework or Bilibili feature is included. Previous published release assets remain unchanged.

The CUDA download continues at the [independent component release](https://github.com/airanluo-dot/DropSpace/releases/tag/cuda-llama-cpp-v0.5.0-cuda13-win-x64-v1); only the small App-bound metadata is included with this App release.
